apps.name: Jackbox Party Packs
apps.about: Party games for 3 to 8+ players. The TV shows the game; everyone plays on their own phone at jackbox.tv, no app needed. Opens a store search, since each pack is its own app.

apps.name: AirConsole
apps.about: Over 100 party games where your phones are the controllers. Open it here, then point phones at airconsole.com and type the code on screen. Some games need AirConsole Hero.

apps.name: SuperTuxKart
apps.about: Open-source kart racer with online races. Plug in a controller for the best feel.

apps.name: GeForce NOW
apps.about: Cloud gaming: play PC games you own on Steam, Epic, Xbox and more, run on NVIDIA's servers. Free tier with time limits; needs a fast connection (25 Mbps or more, 5 GHz Wi-Fi or Ethernet) and a controller.

apps.name: Boosteroid
apps.about: Cloud gaming for PC games you own, with a monthly subscription. Needs a fast connection and a controller.

apps.name: Xbox Cloud Gaming
apps.about: Stream Game Pass games from Xbox's servers in the web player. Needs Game Pass Ultimate and a controller. If the site says this browser isn't supported, it hasn't come to TVs yet.

apps.name: Amazon Luna
apps.about: Amazon's cloud gaming, with games included with Prime that rotate, and add-on channels. On Fire TV, Luna's own app is in the Appstore.

apps.name: RetroArch
apps.about: Emulators for classic consoles with up to 4 controllers on one TV, plus Netplay to play online with friends. Bring games you own or homebrew; none are included.

apps.name: Lemuroid
apps.about: Simple, TV-friendly retro emulator with local multiplayer. Bring games you own or homebrew.

apps.name: PPSSPP
apps.about: PSP emulator that runs well on streaming sticks, with ad hoc multiplayer over your network. Bring games you own.

apps.name: Moonlight
apps.about: Stream games from your own gaming PC (NVIDIA or Sunshine) to the TV, with every controller passed through.

apps.name: Steam Link
apps.about: Play your Steam library from your PC on the TV, including Remote Play Together for local multiplayer games.
